findings.problem: The existing-evidence workflow did not expose client log-window limits: a label selector can impose an implicit ten-line tail even when an incident since-time is requested, and kubectl logs does not retrieve rotated files.
findings.evidence: Kubernetes 1.35 kubectl/logging docs and tagged v1.31.0 logs.go establish selectorTail=10, explicit TailSpecified behavior and retained-log-file coverage.
findings.correction: Added routed capture guard and explicit line/byte/time limits, source mapping, returned-window recording and marker-based control. Keep a deliberate small sample valid but label its coverage.
findings.consequence: Prevents claiming complete incident evidence or no errors from a silently limited export.

findings.problem: Prior container log retrieval was not distinguished from replacement-Pod history, leaving a gap in the promised restart-survivability protocol.
findings.evidence: Kubernetes 1.35 --previous contract is previous container instance in the selected Pod; default kubelet retention keeps one terminated container's logs, and replacement Pod has a new UID even if its name is reused.
findings.correction: Preserve Pod UID/container identity/restart and termination state, record capture races or missing prior data, and choose retained backend/approved node evidence without extending recovery authority.
findings.consequence: Avoids labeling a replacement's clean output as evidence from the failed process.
